reasons.preprocessing_pipeline.pkl: Extracted from final_model.pkl: all transform-capable pipeline steps preceding the classifier.
reasons.shap_explainer.pkl: Regenerated a TreeExplainer directly from the fitted RandomForestClassifier in final_model.pkl.
reasons.optimal_threshold.json: The threshold selected during original model development was not persisted anywhere reachable from final_model.pkl or the recovered training artifacts, so it cannot be reconstructed without the original validation-set predictions.
reasons.evaluation_metrics.csv: Original evaluation-set metrics were not persisted in a form reachable from this deployment folder; fabricating numeric values would misrepresent model performance, so a documented N/A placeholder is written instead.
